Measured on 2026-11-06 with dspk 0.0.6, on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 with Max-Q Design · Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) · Linux 7.2.15-300.fc45.x86_64.

One 384 × 60000 float32 block (2 s of Neuropixels at 30 kHz). Each time is the median of 5 calls after a warm-up, end to end from a NumPy array (upload, kernels, download) for dspk; scipy / numpy in float64 on the CPU. Error: max |dspk − scipy| / max |scipy|.

## Time (ms)

| Operation | CUDA | wgpu | CPU runtime | SciPy / NumPy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| zero-phase band-pass | 233 | 281 | 336 | 525 |
| causal band-pass | 202 | 257 | 258 | 259 |
| notch 60 Hz | 234 | 314 | 263 | 2461 |
| FIR 101 taps | 209 | 230 | 258 | 605 |
| median width 5 | 203 | 217 | 210 | 1042 |
| resample 1/3 | 156 | 194 | 163 | 556 |
| common median reference | 220 | 249 | 425 | 316 |

Most of each dspk time is the 92 MB transfer to the device and back. Chaining stages in a [pipeline](/dsp-kitchen/operations/pipelines/) pays for that transfer once.

## Agreement (largest difference, relative to SciPy's peak)

| Operation | CUDA | wgpu | CPU runtime | Tolerance | Passed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| zero-phase band-pass | 2.4e-06 | 2.4e-06 | 2.4e-06 | 1e-05 | yes |
| causal band-pass | 1.1e-06 | 1.1e-06 | 1.1e-06 | 1e-05 | yes |
| notch 60 Hz | 4.1e-06 | 4.3e-06 | 3.6e-06 | 1e-05 | yes |
| FIR 101 taps | 6.5e-07 | 6.5e-07 | 6.5e-07 | 1e-05 | yes |
| median width 5 | 0.0e+00 | 0.0e+00 | 0.0e+00 | 1e-06 | yes |
| resample 1/3 | 7.2e-07 | 7.2e-07 | 7.2e-07 | 1e-05 | yes |
| common median reference | 0.0e+00 | 0.0e+00 | 0.0e+00 | 1e-06 | yes |

dspk works in float32 on the device, and SciPy in float64, so filters agree to float32 level. Median and common median reference are exact.

## Run it yourself

```sh
uv run python benchmarks/signal-operations/scipy_timing.py --repeats 5
```

Build with `maturin develop --release` first, and run each benchmark in a fresh process.
